programOutcomes.title: Engineering Knowledge
programOutcomes.statement: Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science, engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex engineering problems.

programOutcomes.title: Problem Analysis
programOutcomes.statement: Identify, formulate, review research literature, and analyze complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.

programOutcomes.title: Design/Development of Solutions
programOutcomes.statement: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, and cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.

programOutcomes.title: Conduct Investigations of Complex Problems
programOutcomes.statement: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.

programOutcomes.title: Modern Tool Usage
programOutcomes.statement: Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modeling to complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.

programOutcomes.title: The Engineer and Society
programOutcomes.statement: Apply reasoning informed by contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues and the consequent responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.

programOutcomes.title: Environment and Sustainability
programOutcomes.statement: Understand the impact of the professional engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the knowledge of, and need for sustainable development.

programOutcomes.title: Ethics
programOutcomes.statement: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.

programOutcomes.title: Individual and Team Work
programOutcomes.statement: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.

programOutcomes.title: Communication
programOutcomes.statement: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and with society at large, such as being able to comprehend and write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and receive clear instructions.

programOutcomes.title: Project Management and Finance
programOutcomes.statement: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the engineering and management principles and apply these to one's own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

programOutcomes.title: Life-long Learning
programOutcomes.statement: Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of technological change.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Systems & Software Engineering
programSpecificOutcomes.statement: Architect, implement, test, and deploy resilient software and scalable enterprise infrastructure using modern distributed paradigms, robust design patterns, and rigorous security standards.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Intelligent Systems & Data Science
programSpecificOutcomes.statement: Design and validate cognitive pipelines, mathematical models, machine learning algorithms, and real-time data analytical solutions to solve high-complexity domain problems.

programSpecificOutcomes.title: Engineering Research & Professional Practice
programSpecificOutcomes.statement: Execute interdisciplinary applied research, adapt to emerging algorithmic frameworks, and deliver human-centered technological solutions adhering to global regulatory and ethical benchmarks.

bloomsLevels.name: Remember
bloomsLevels.description: Retrieve relevant knowledge from long-term memory; recognize, list, describe, retrieve, name, identify facts and core concepts.

bloomsLevels.name: Understand
bloomsLevels.description: Construct meaning from instructional messages; interpret, classify, summarize, infer, compare, explain ideas and concepts.

bloomsLevels.name: Apply
bloomsLevels.description: Carry out or use a procedure in a given situation; execute or implement formulas, algorithms, or theories to solve concrete problems.

bloomsLevels.name: Analyze
bloomsLevels.description: Break material into constituent parts and determine how parts relate to one another and to an overall structure; differentiate, organize, attribute.

bloomsLevels.name: Evaluate
bloomsLevels.description: Make judgments based on criteria and standards; check, critique, assess the validity, efficiency, or feasibility of solutions.

bloomsLevels.name: Create
bloomsLevels.description: Put elements together to form a coherent or functional whole; reorganize elements into a new pattern or structure through generating, planning, or producing.

correlationLevels.label: None (–)
correlationLevels.description: No measurable direct correlation between this Course Outcome and Program Outcome.

correlationLevels.label: Slight (Low)
correlationLevels.description: Marginal correlation; addresses the outcome superficially or as a minor prerequisite (10-30% curriculum weight).

correlationLevels.label: Moderate (Medium)
correlationLevels.description: Direct contribution; substantial focus in lectures, labs, and evaluation (30-60% curriculum weight).

correlationLevels.label: Substantial (High)
correlationLevels.description: Primary driver; central learning objective with comprehensive assessment and major project focus (>60% curriculum weight).
